title: Design Review
description: Design review where the navigation debate never reaches a decision and a question about the palette goes unanswered.

transcript.speaker: Priya
transcript.text: Thanks for joining the design review. First item is the new navigation.

transcript.speaker: Rahul
transcript.text: I prototyped the left sidebar with six sections.

transcript.speaker: Sneha
transcript.text: Six feels heavy for mobile. I would cut it to four.

transcript.speaker: Rahul
transcript.text: If we cut sections we lose direct access to billing.

transcript.speaker: Priya
transcript.text: The billing entry point matters for the dashboard redesign.

transcript.speaker: Sneha
transcript.text: Then we need a decision on whether billing stays in the sidebar or moves to the profile menu.

transcript.speaker: Rahul
transcript.text: I can build both variants by Thursday if that helps.

transcript.speaker: Priya
transcript.text: Let's revisit after lunch, next topic is the color system.

transcript.speaker: Sneha
transcript.text: The current blue fails contrast on white backgrounds.

transcript.speaker: Arjun
transcript.text: I ran the accessibility audit and the ratio is 3.1 to 1.

transcript.speaker: Sneha
transcript.text: WCAG requires 4.5 to 1 for body text, so we are failing.

transcript.speaker: Priya
transcript.text: Can anyone tell me who approved the current palette?

transcript.speaker: Rahul
transcript.text: Anyway, moving on to the spacing scale.

transcript.speaker: Sneha
transcript.text: The 8 point grid works fine so far.

transcript.speaker: Priya
transcript.text: Hello? Nobody knows who approved the palette?

transcript.speaker: Rahul
transcript.text: We can ask the brand team offline.
